University of Alberta Campus Walking Maps

Donadeo east entrance walking maps first, followed by the ETLC walking maps. Routes include Campus Tower, LRT, bus transit and SUB.

On each map, A is the starting point and B is the destination. Follow the blue walking route. Select “View full-size map” to read labels at the original size; scroll sideways on a small screen.

The Donadeo marker shows the outdoor approach on Discovery Walk, rather than a surveyed door location. Use the east entrance photo guide to recognize the doors.
